## Fixes

- **Device list no longer gets stuck on "Not found device".** In 1.6.0 the list stopped
  refreshing if adb was not running yet when the app started, which is every first launch.
- Screen mirroring that fails to start now shows a message with the reason instead of doing
  nothing.
- The device list says when a device needs the debugging prompt accepted, or is offline.
- Settings can no longer be lost when two parts of the app save at the same moment.
- Pair and Disconnect accept the same pasted address formats as Connect.

## Logs

- **Stop** and **Save** are now separate. Stopping no longer opens a file dialog, and a capture
  is not lost if you cancel saving.
- New save dialog: the file name includes the device and time, the folder is remembered
  (Documents by default), and you can save everything or only the lines the current search and
  level filter show. After saving, use **Open folder** or **Copy path**.
- **Clear** during a capture really clears: cleared lines stay out of the saved file.
- The empty Logs screen explains what to do.

## Easier for first-time users

- The Wireless dialog has a "Where do I find these?" link with the steps to turn on debugging
  on a TV and find its IP address, and a plain hint when connecting fails.
- Command box: Up/Down arrows recall earlier commands, and a history button lists recent ones.
- The Output pane starts larger.

See [CHANGES.md](https://github.com/TonciZ/QA-Adbpad/blob/main/CHANGES.md) for details.
